output.summary: A biennial wildflower native to southeastern Europe, Mediterranean Turkey and North Africa, purple salsify has grasslike leaves, milky stems and purple flower heads. Its root and young shoots are eaten after boiling, while fresh leaves may be eaten raw or cooked; after flowering, the root becomes stringy and inedible.
